meta.title: Jx Care: skin and hair care, kept on your phone
meta.description: Jx Care keeps track of your skin and hair care products, when each one expires, what to use morning and evening, and how your skin changes week to week. Free, private, in Lithuanian and English.

hero.title: Know what to put on today
hero.lead: Jx Care keeps track of your skin and hair care products: when each one expires, what to use in the morning and evening, when to wash your hair, and how your skin changes week to week. Everything stays on your phone, behind a PIN.
hero.soon: Coming to iOS and Android. It is not in the App Store or Google Play yet.

sample.liveDemo: Jx Care running with sample data. Tap the tabs to look around.

streak.title: Skin streak
streak.weekLabel: Last 7 days: 6 done, today still to do

conflict.title: Retinol conflicts with AHA.
conflict.text: Both are in Evening B on Tuesdays. You can still save.

ingredients.title: Ingredients
ingredients.hint: Parfum is on your avoid list. You can still save.

photos.title: Progress photos
photos.label: Two weekly skin photos side by side, 8 Sep and 6 Oct

accounts.label: Accounts to create
accounts.text: No sign-up and no server. Your products, routines and photos are saved on your phone and open with a PIN, Face ID or fingerprint.

tracking.label: Ads and trackers
tracking.text: Nothing is sent anywhere. The only thing that leaves the phone is a backup file, when you export one.

gallery.label: Photos in your gallery
gallery.text: Progress photos stay inside the app, so they never show up in the phone's gallery or photo backups.

languages.label: Languages
languages.text: Lithuanian and English, in light and dark.

price.label: Price
price.text: Free to use, and the code is open for anyone to read.

features.title: What you'll find inside
features.lead: Six areas, one Today screen. Jx Care shows only what is due, so a routine takes a minute at the bathroom shelf.

shelf.title: Your shelf
shelf.text: Every product with its brand, photo, size, price, ingredients and whether it is for skin, hair or both.
shelf.example: filter by Skin or Hair, or sort by soonest expiry.

expiry.title: Expiry dates
expiry.text: Jx Care works out when each product expires from the printed date, the day you opened it and how long it lasts after opening.
expiry.example: a reminder 30 days before, and an OK, Expiring soon or Expired badge on every row.

notes.title: Product notes
notes.text: Dated notes on how your skin reacted, a 1 to 5 rating and whether you would buy it again.
notes.example: "small breakout on chin", noted on 3 Oct.

costPerDay.title: Cost per day
costPerDay.text: When a product is finished, Jx Care divides its price by the days you used it.

timeOfDay.title: Morning, evening or your own
timeOfDay.text: Each routine has a time of day, the weekdays it runs and its steps in order, each linked to a product.
timeOfDay.example: Morning: cleanser, vitamin C, moisturiser, sunscreen.

alternatives.title: A and B
alternatives.text: Two routines can share a time of day on different days. Today shows the one that is due.
alternatives.example: Evening A with retinol on Mon, Wed and Fri; Evening B with an exfoliant on Tue and Thu.

stepSchedule.title: Steps on their own days
stepSchedule.text: A step can run every time, on set days, or every few days, so one routine covers the whole week.
stepSchedule.example: a face mask only on Sundays.

player.title: Tick as you go
player.text: Start a routine and tick each step, or tap All done. Steps can have a wait timer before the next one.
player.example: wait 60 seconds after an acid toner.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.text: A local reminder at the time you pick. It stays quiet if the routine is already done.

washCycle.title: Wash days
washCycle.text: Set how often you wash. The next wash counts from the last one, so washing early or late moves it.
washCycle.example: every 3 days with shampoo, conditioner and a mask every second wash.

otherCare.title: Other care
otherCare.text: Trims, colour and scrubs with their own rhythm, and how long ago each one was.
otherCare.example: last trim 7 weeks ago, next one in a week.

streaks.title: Two streaks
streaks.text: Separate skin and hair streaks with your best. A day with nothing set never breaks them.
streaks.example: "Started again. Your best is still 21 days."

conflicts.title: Conflicts across the day
conflicts.text: Jx Care checks every product you use on the same day, morning and evening, against your list of pairs that should not meet.
conflicts.example: retinol with AHA shows a Conflict tag on both steps.

groups.title: Ingredient groups
groups.text: Group ingredients once and set conflicts between groups instead of every pair.
groups.example: "Acids" holds glycolic, lactic and salicylic acid.

avoid.title: Avoid list
avoid.text: Ingredients you never want. A product that contains one gets a warning and an Avoid badge.

weeklyPhoto.title: Weekly photo
weeklyPhoto.text: A guided photo once a week, with the last photo faintly over the camera so the angle and distance line up.
weeklyPhoto.example: front, left and right side, in the same light.

compare.title: Compare
compare.text: Any two weeks side by side, with what you started or stopped using in between.

condition.title: Check-in
condition.text: One tap for how your skin and hair feel today, shown next to the routines you did.
condition.example: Calm, Glow, Oily, Dry, Breakout, Redness, Itchy.

buyAgain.title: Buy again
buyAgain.text: Finished and expiring products are offered for the list. Nothing is added without your tap.
buyAgain.example: the list shows the price and size you paid last time.

addAsNew.title: Add as new product
addAsNew.text: Tick an item when bought and Jx Care copies its details into a new product with today's date.
addAsNew.example: name, brand, size and ingredients, ready to save.

share.title: Share the list
share.text: Send the list as plain text to take to the shop.
share.example: to yourself in a messaging app.

privacy.title: Private by design
privacy.lead: Jx Care is for one person on one phone. There is no account to lose and nothing to sync.

pin.title: PIN, Face ID or fingerprint
pin.text: The app locks every time it opens and after a minute away. A forgotten PIN is reset with your recovery question.

switcher.title: Hidden in the app switcher
switcher.text: While locked, the app's content is blurred when you switch between apps.

photos.title: Photos stay in the app
photos.text: Progress photos are kept in the app's own storage and are only visible after the PIN.

backup.title: Your backup, your file
backup.text: Export everything to one file and restore it on a new phone. Photos are included only if you choose.

close.getText: Jx Care is not in the stores yet. Watch the code on GitHub to see when it is.
close.buildText: Jx Care is free and open source. The guide on GitHub shows how to build it for iOS or Android.
close.suggestText: Write to me about what you would like Jx Care to do and how you would use it.
close.supportText: Jx Care is built and kept up by one developer.

footer: Skin and hair care, kept on your phone · Free and open source
